name: TestimonialsSection
description: A full-bleed section component for displaying client testimonials in a carousel layout. Requires an opinionated layout: section header (label + heading), a looping auto-play carousel of testimonial cards, and prev/next navigation. Must integrate with the existing Carousel, Card, Avatar, and Text primitives internally.
designNotes: Cards should have a large opening quotation mark rendered in the primary color. Author attribution sits below the quote with Avatar (image or initials fallback) on the left and name/role stacked on the right. Background glow treatment similar to ContactSection. Auto-play should pause on hover/focus for accessibility.
accessibilityNotes: Carousel must be navigable by keyboard. Auto-play must be pauseable and must respect prefers-reduced-motion (disable auto-play if motion is reduced). ARIA live region for current slide announcement.
exampleUsage: See composition in src/app/page.tsx — Testimonials section
